# FG-GIT-0018

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`repo-maintenance`](../../ops/runbooks/repo-maintenance.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_failing_gc_is_repository_maintenance_failed` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: リポジトリの定期の保守に失敗しました。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The scheduled maintenance of the repository failed. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Pemeliharaan terjadwal repositori gagal. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

A step of the `repository.maintain` job (M3 O3, ADR-0024 "実装で決めたこと（O3）") failed: `git gc --cruft --prune=<grace>` (with `-c gc.packRefs=false`, bitmaps, no commit-graph), `git pack-refs --all` (under the merge lock), `git commit-graph write --reachable`, or the object / ref counts. git exited non-zero or printed output forge cannot read; nothing a user did. A timeout of a step stays FG-GIT-0002 (`step`, the step's process tree killed) and no free git slot FG-GIT-0004. The repository keeps working (clone, push, merge do not depend on maintenance), but unreferenced objects (trial merges, superseded merge commits, force-pushed history) are not pruned and packs are not consolidated while it fails. doctor `repositories.maintenance` turns this into an alert after two consecutive failures of one repository (`reason=failing`), or when a repository is past its due time by more than one interval (`reason=overdue`).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

One warn event `forge.git.maintenance_completed` with `outcome=failed`, `error_code`, `request_id` (the job's), `repo_id`, `step` (`gc`, `pack_refs`, `commit_graph`, `counts`), `exit_code` and the redacted head of git's `stderr`; `reason=unexpected_output` (with `subcommand`) when `count-objects -v` / `for-each-ref` printed something forge cannot read. The ledger row (read-only): `SELECT repo_id, outcome, error_code, failures, last_started_at, last_finished_at, next_due_at FROM forge.repository_maintenance WHERE repo_id = <id>`. `forge doctor` `repositories.maintenance` lists failing and overdue repositories. Reproduce read-only with `git -C <path from forge admin repo-path> count-objects -v` and `git fsck --connectivity-only --no-dangling`.

## 対処 (fix)

Act on git's stderr: disk full or permissions on the storage root (runbook repo-storage), a stale lock file (`gc.pid` older than 12 h is ignored by git; a `packed-refs.lock` or `<ref>.lock` older than the longest push needs approval to remove — runbook repo-maintenance), or corruption (fsck → FG-GIT-0019). Then run the maintenance again: `forge admin repo maintain <repo_id>` (enqueues one job).
